antithesis: Prolonged exposure at 700nm may decrease mitochondrial biogenesis and generate oxidative stress in osteoblast if irradiance exceeds optimal threshold. Paper (2025) notes dose-dependent tissue response.
synthesis: Apply Transcranial 870nm: neuron-specific at 345 THz, low irradiance 22.2 mW/cm^2, 40min targeting osteoblast_mitochondria in osteoblast. Study reference: 2025 peer-reviewed paper shows respiration +18% at 700nm. Dual-phase protocol minimizes off-target thermal effects while maximizing mitochondrial pyruvate_dehydrogenase activation.
